name: mlefree
description: Mat’s Cloud — a real Fidj generator integration and CI fixture

scripts.create:
node "${FIDJ_GENERATOR_DIR:-../../ofidj/generator-fidj}/bin/create-fidj.cjs" .gen/mleweb --replace --app-id fidj-f46d11011e19ef90 --api-endpoint https://api.fidj.ovh/v3 --sdk-path "${FIDJ_SDK_DIR:-../../ofidj/fidj-node/dist}" --title "Mat Cloud App" --welcome "Welcome in my Cloud" --content "

About me
Work with me on fidj or feel free to contact
twitter - hello@mlefree.com
" --domain mlefree.com && npm install --prefix .gen/mleweb --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build-prod --prefix .gen/mleweb
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm test --prefix .gen/mleweb
